topic: 限时听力：地图、设施与说明
grammarFocus: 位置介词、顺序表达、比较与变化描述。
title: Timed Listening in Public Spaces: Maps, Facilities and Instructions
prompt: In many public buildings, such as transport interchanges, hospitals and museums, visitors now receive spoken directions and information about maps and facilities through timed audio announcements rather than from staff or printed signs. Some people believe these timed listening systems make public spaces easier to use, while others argue they create confusion and disadvantage certain users. Discuss both views and give your own opinion. Write at least 250 words.
instructions: 本题为模拟练习，所有场景与数据均为虚构，并非官方雅思试题。写作时请先分别说明支持与反对限时听力系统的理由，再明确给出你自己的立场，并用具体例子支撑。注意任务要求讨论双方观点并表明个人看法，不要只描述现象或罗列优缺点。建议用约40分钟完成，写前花几分钟规划段落结构，确保每个主体段围绕一个核心论点展开，并在结论中重申你的立场。
